tagline: Interactive stories told by AI. _One backend_ for Android, iOS and web.
pitch: {product} is a Kuku FM product. You play a story act by act, or chat with a character. On Google Play in the US, on the web from anywhere, and submitted to the App Store.
summary: My first commit was the playable MVP. I use AI coding tools like Claude Code to move faster. The product calls, system design, code reviews, testing and releases are mine.
availability: The Android app is on Google Play in the US only, not in India yet. The web app at playoshi.app works from anywhere.
